## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; hardware-dependent tests are marked
- [ ] Feature parity: service function + CLI + API + UI (or a linked follow-up issue)
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/gen_api_client.py` run if API models changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] No performance or hardware-support claims without recorded measurements
